subject.title: The menu bar display style has an issue.

question: Should the layout editor retain drag-and-drop as its sole editing model, or should it add explicit per-token removal and reordering controls after a current-release reproduction is confirmed?
rationale: The issue mixes a possible rendering defect with a request for a more direct editing model, and the intended interaction contract is not established by the report.

options.title: Reproduce before expanding controls
options.body: Verify the reported configuration on v0.45.2 and repair any broken drag/drop or vertical alignment behavior before considering new editor controls.

options.title: Add explicit token controls
options.body: Treat the current drag-and-drop model as insufficient and add accessible remove/reorder affordances with focused settings-state tests.

recommendation.title: Reproduce before expanding controls
recommendation.body: Verify the reported configuration on v0.45.2 and repair any broken drag/drop or vertical alignment behavior before considering new editor controls.

likelyOwner.reason: Low-confidence routing candidate based on repository ownership and the recent menu-bar layout release work.
